thread:
Kevin: Quick kickoff for LatticeCare case + launch webinar. Need interview slots, a short benchmark stat to drop in the launch post, final pull quote signoff, headshots, and legal embargo date. Target publish window is the 21st.

Julia: I can coordinate interviews. Recommend 25m slots Tue/Wed next week midday PT. @kevin which day do you want the CEO slot?

Sam: For the benchmark, I can run a lightweight latency sweep on their anonymized triage prompts in staging. Will return median token latency and a single comparative line for the blog. Need customer signoff to run tests.

Ravi: Asset list: final approved quote, CEO + Head of Data headshots, SVG logo, and 3 short social clips. I'll prep hero comps once quote locked.

Kevin: Draft pull quote: ```
"Redwood helped us shorten processing times so care coordinators can focus on higher-value work."
```

legal-bot: Recommendation: add attribution and avoid absolute language. Suggest: "In our tests, Redwood reduced processing time in our environment, helping care coordinators focus on higher-value work." Confirm no PHI in transcript. Expect 48-72h review.

Kevin: Updated per legal: "In our tests, Redwood reduced processing time in our environment, helping care coordinators focus on higher-value work." Can legal confirm?

legal-bot: Approve with tiny edit: change "care coordinators" -> "care teams" for broader term. Final: "In our tests, Redwood reduced processing time in our environment, helping care teams focus on higher-value work." Marking green pending customer signoff.

Sam: Scheduling perf run Thu 09:00 PT. Will post a single-line stat + appendix link here after completion.

Julia: Tentatively booked CEO Wed 11:00 PT and Head of Data Wed 11:30 PT; invites include media consent with checkbox. I attached a draft consent: "I consent to be contacted about this case study and for my organization to appear in Redwood marketing materials." Thoughts?

Kevin: Consent copy looks good. Customer requested an embargo until the 21st; please note. Also asked to remove any PHI examples in the draft transcript.

ops-bot: Lead routing configured: utm_campaign=lattice_launch; tag=lattice-case; leads -> /queues/enterprise-sdr. Consent param captured as consent_marketing=true. :gear:

Sam: Perf job finished: median token latency 78ms vs 230ms baseline -> "~2.95x median latency improvement in our tests." Appendix: https://app.internal/benchmarks/lattice-1812349999. Recommended stat line: "~2.95x median latency improvement (in our tests)."

legal-bot: That phrasing is fine with attribution and appendix. Please add a short methodology note on the landing page. Keeping priority flag.

Ravi: Headshots and logo uploaded to the case folder. I'll wait for final quote to finalize hero options.

Julia: Customer approved quote edit over email and confirmed embargo to 21st. They also asked to add "care teams" replacement which we updated.

Kevin: Summary: interviews scheduled (Julia), perf stat + appendix (Sam), legal OK on language (legal-bot), assets uploaded (Ravi), lead routing set (ops-bot), embargo 21st. Will assemble final publish package Mon morning.

Julia: I'll attach transcripts after interviews and ping for final signoff.

Kevin: Thanks all — will follow up Mon AM with checklist. :thumbsup:
